name: incident-postmortem
title: Incident postmortem
description: A blameless post-incident report: severity in words, impact in tabular figures, a UTC timeline, the root cause in plain words and actions with owners.
docs: Pass the incident (id, title, severity as critical, major or minor with an optional code such as SEV 2, start and end as ISO times, what was affected, and a summary that can be several paragraphs), the impact (figures with a label, a number or text, and a note, plus a body), the timeline (events with a time, text and an optional milestone word such as Detected, Mitigated or Resolved), the rootCause (a one-sentence summary, an explanation and contributing factors), the lessons (wentWell and wentPoorly) and the actions (title, owner, due date and status as done, in-progress or planned, with an optional ticket and link). Blameless by design: owners are teams, and a person is shown only when you pass person. Every section has an anchor and a link beside its heading, so #timeline sends a customer straight to the timeline; idPrefix keeps the anchors apart when a page holds more than one report. All times are written in one zone, UTC by default (timeZone), with the time since the start beside each event, a day label when the incident spans midnight, and a duration worked out from the two ends or Ongoing when there is no end. A contents list follows the reader beside the page on wide screens and becomes a row of links on a phone; the actions table becomes cards below 768px. Events are sorted by time, numbers are tabular, and linkAs routes the ticket links. Pass labels to translate every fixed word and note to change or remove the blameless line.
